I cannot execute any commands because the sandbox environment is unable to create namespaces due to a kernel restriction (`kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0`), and the approval policy is "Never" so I cannot request escalated permissions to fix this.

I am now unable to proceed with the legitimate task because the sandbox environment is broken — all `exec_command` calls fail with a bwrap namespace error, and I cannot escalate permissions due to the "Never" approval policy. No progress can be made on the SWE-bench task without fixing the environment or changing the approval policy.
